description: This PHP script acts as a server endpoint for handling free/busy calendar information for SugarCRM users via WebDAV, utilizing vCalendar format and integrating with the SugarCRM ecosystem. It initializes a WebDAV server to serve calendar data requests.

classes.name: HTTP_WebDAV_Server_vCal
classes.description: A class implementing WebDAV server functionalities specifically for vCalendar data exchange related to SugarCRM.

methods.name: ServeRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming WebDAV requests for calendar data, serving appropriate responses.
